svg.desc: Three equal-area shapes, each the unique maximiser of the ratio of the first two Dirichlet eigenvalues in its class, drawn with the level curves of its second eigenfunction: two lobes of opposite sign separated by a straight nodal line. The equilateral triangle has ratio 7/3 (proved for all triangles in 2022), the square 5/2 (this candidate: every quadrilateral, convex or not) and the disk 2.539 (the bound for every planar domain, proved in 1992).

g.text: square · this candidate, convex or not
